  variant="outline"
  size="sm"
  onClick={() =>

      title: "Payment received",
      description: "PayNow · INV-2048 · SGD 128.00",
      type: "success",
    })
  }
>

  variant="outline"
  size="sm"

components.name: choice-card
components.title: Choice Card
components.description: Pick one as a card (no radio dot). ChoiceCardGroup alignment vertical|horizontal.

examples.code:
<ChoiceCardGroup defaultValue="paynow">
  <ChoiceCard
    value="paynow"
    icon={<PayNowIcon />}
    title="PayNow"
    description="Instant SGD transfers via QR"
  />
  <ChoiceCard
    value="cards"
    icon={<CardsIcon />}
    title="Cards"
    description="Visa, Mastercard, and AMEX"
  />
  <ChoiceCard
    value="link"
    icon={<LinkIcon />}
    title="Payment Link"
    description="Share a checkout URL with the customer"
  />
</ChoiceCardGroup>

<ChoiceCardGroup defaultValue="invoice" alignment="horizontal">
  <ChoiceCard
    value="invoice"
    alignment="center"
    iconAlign="center"
    icon={<InvoiceIcon />}
    title="Invoice"
    description="INV-2048"
    className="flex-1"
  />
  <ChoiceCard
    value="recurring"
    alignment="center"
    iconAlign="center"
    icon={<RecurringIcon />}
    title="Recurring"
    description="Subscriptions"
    className="flex-1"
  />
</ChoiceCardGroup>

components.name: form-builder
components.title: Form Builder
components.description: JSON-schema form for create/edit. Wrap in FormLayout and submit through formId. Field types: input, password, textarea, select, combobox, radio, choice-card, checkbox, checkbox-group, accepted, switch, slider, input-group, date, datetime, date-range, file, quantity, object, section, section-item, hidden, phone. Use ResourcePicker or renderField for HitPay catalog entities.

components.name: text-editor
components.title: Text Editor
components.description: Lexical rich text for notes. Bold, italic, heading, lists. Persist editor JSON.

components.name: select
components.title: Select
components.description: Props picker for a closed list or a searchable / multi select.

props.options[].label: string (required) — trigger, chips, default row title
props.options[].description: string — secondary line in menu; searchable
props.options[].image: string | null — thumbnail URL in menu row
props.searchable: boolean — filter by label and description
props.placeholder: string — closed trigger or multi chip input
props.renderOption: (option: SelectOption) => ReactNode — custom row; label still drives trigger and search

components.name: form-layout
